{{Top|leg}}
'''Scissorfists''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of large crustacean found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. According to [[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin's]] ''[[Wild Power]]'' writings they had claws that were impossible to open when latched to an attacker's skin.<ref name="BOS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref> The [[Scissorfists Clan]] was named after the creature.<ref name="backlash">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Backlash]]''</ref>
